This [[uniform polyhedron compound]] is a symmetric arrangement of 12 [[pentagonal prism]]s, aligned in pairs with the axes of fivefold rotational symmetry of a [[dodecahedron]].

It results from composing the two [[Chirality (mathematics)|enantiomorphs]] of the [[compound of six pentagonal prisms]]. In doing so, the vertices of the two enantiomorphs coincide, with the result that the full compound has two pentagonal prisms incident on each of its vertices.
